description: Negative control for todo steering. shouldSteerTodos() has four mustNotSteerTodos fixture cases, but no scenario has ever exercised the negative side end-to-end — over-steering (a plan for a one-paragraph question) is only checked at the matcher level. Uses a mustNotSteerTodos prompt verbatim so the matrix and this eval cannot drift apart.
prompts: Explain what TodoItem.status means in one paragraph.
